rows.text: The party's 1999 presidential election page gives the count (開票結果): 小渕恵三 Diet-member votes 253, member-derived votes 97, total 350; 加藤紘一 85, 28, 113; 山崎拓 33, 18, 51. Its event list places the count of member ballots at 09:00 and of Diet-member ballots at 16:00 on 21 September, the extraordinary party convention at 13:00 on 22 September and the new president's press conference at 14:30 on 22 September.
